title: Settings
subtitle: Manage your account and organization.
languageSubtitle: Choose how SequrAI speaks to you. Product names stay in English.
mcpSubtitle: Connect your code agent to your Production Verdict and blocker tools via MCP.
mcpPromoTitle: Use SequrAI in your code agent with MCP
mcpPromoBody: Ask "Can I deploy?", audit your app, and get Safe Fix prompts without leaving your editor.
mcpCopyKeyBody: This key is shown once. It gives access only to the current Workspace. It is embedded in the MCP config below as a Bearer token.
mcpCursorSetupBody: Paste this into `.cursor/mcp.json` in your project root. No SequrAI repo or local files required.
mcpSetupFileHint: Create or edit `.cursor/mcp.json` in the project you are building — not inside the SequrAI app.
mcpUniversalIntro: Generate a key, then connect with one terminal command — works for Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code, and any MCP agent that accepts a remote URL.
mcpUniversalBody: Same connection for every code agent: one remote URL and one Bearer token.
mcpUniversalCommandBody: Run this in your project folder. It configures Cursor, Claude Code, and VS Code automatically.
mcpUniversalManualBody: In your agent: Settings → MCP → Add remote server, then paste these two values.
mcpUniversalSecurityNote: This connection includes your private API key. Do not share the command or header publicly.
workspaceManageDescription: Switch between Workspaces you can access.
deleteAccountDescription: Permanently delete your account, workspace data, and cancel any active subscription.
